title: Borax Argentina
description: boraxargentina.com Borax Argentina S.A.I.C. is an Argentine mining and chemical company founded in 1978, operating as a subsidiary of Rio Tinto and producing borate minerals and boric acid from mines in Salta and Jujuy provinces. With approximately 500 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 150 to 300 million dollars, it runs the Tincalayu complex, Argentina's largest borate processing facility, and exports to over 30 countries. Its product range includes borax pentahydrate, boric acid, anhydrous borax and ulexite serving glass, ceramics, agriculture, detergents, metallurgy, pharmaceuticals and nuclear industries. The company is vertically integrated from mining through processing to global export via its own port facilities. As part of Rio Tinto Borates alongside the Boron mine in California, it is a key player in the global borate market. Growing demand from renewable energy, electric vehicles and micronutrient agriculture drives its strategic importance.
